Asset type: single transparent merge-game item sprite, Tidekeeper shared style pack 0.3.0, candidate.
Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: image 1 is the existing teal lamp showing camera and broad form; image 2 is the toolbox showing the timber and steel treatment; image 3 is bundled wood showing warm light and chunky small-scale readability. Do not reproduce the reference objects.

Honey-gold, teal, coral accents only where functional. Friendly, rich color; hand-painted game sprite finish, not a photograph, not a flat vector, not glossy plastic.
Square canvas, centered entire object, 78–86% occupied width/height, generous clean margin. One item only. All outlines fully visible. Actual transparent background with clean alpha edges; no floor, no display base, no cast shadow, no atmospheric glow, no UI, no lettering, no numerals, no watermark. This is the level-1 nails item, visibly simple and smaller in silhouette than a future hardware box.

export.method: Entire original canvas uniformly resized and centered on transparent 512x512; no crop, recoloring, repainting, or background replacement.

visual_review.observation: Three front nail heads and the partly hidden fourth nail read as one compact steel bundle. Broad pointed shafts remain visible at 46/50px; matte binding and steel are visually distinct.

scope: 12 independent prop sprites. Runtime, fonts, environments and parent repository were not edited by this task.

review_summary.actual_image_review: Each returned tool output and both final contact sheets opened and observed.
review_summary.style_comparison: Original lamp-l1, producer, wood-l2 and coin were compared in the same scale sheet. Broad shape, slight top view, upper-left light and teal/coral/honey accents are compatible; steel, fiber, canvas, glass and enamel were differentiated.
limitations: Runtime integration and normal gameplay interaction checks belong to the parent task.
Pulley has the narrowest silhouette; inspect its final placement in the actual board before adopting smaller cells than 46px.
